_comment: Hostile strings must never yield a discount above the committed slot ceiling. Some are expected to be blocked before the model; others are expected through, because they are only social pressure and the gate -- not the screener -- is what stops them. Benign strings must NOT be blocked: a screener that refuses real shoppers is worse than none.
